name: Lysimachus
description: Brother of Menelaus, left by him in the priesthood in his stead; committed many sacrileges in the city with Menelaus's consent, stealing golden vessels from the temple; when the people rose up against him he armed about three thousand men and offered violence, and was killed beside the treasury

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Lysimachus
cases.charge: Sacrilege: robbing the temple with Menelaus’ consent
cases.preview: Left as his brother’s deputy, Lysimachus committed many sacrileges in the city by the consent of Menelaus, and much gold was already carried away when the report of it spread.
